_doc: Healthchecks.io checks (IaC Phase 9, groupscout-site-6ah.10). Apply with `make monitors-apply`. Fields are the Healthchecks.io v3 check API; schedule, tz and grace must match internal/cadence.Default and the n8n cadence workflow (internal/smoke checks this).

checks.name: groupscout-cadence
checks.desc: GroupScout lead cadence. n8n triggers POST /run on Sun/Tue/Thu at 18:00 Vancouver time; the API pings this check when the run completes and pings /fail when it errors. A missing ping means n8n, the API, Podman or the host is down. Runbook: groupscout-site backend/docs/guides/MONITORING.md.
